counterEvidence: Recognition uses exact cancellation markers, and JSON parsing failures are caught; arbitrary prose does not automatically become cancellation. These safeguards do not exclude valid domain JSON containing cancelled:true.
digest: KEEP: successful response text containing domain JSON can satisfy the cancellation predicate without any cancellation envelope.

const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(entry.text);
				if (parsed !== value && isWorkflowReturnedCancellation(parsed)) return true;

finding: Ordinary provider content can be mistaken for workflow cancellation
recommendedAction: Restrict text-based recognition to explicitly identified adapter cancellation envelopes, preserve legacy wrappers explicitly, and add a regression test showing successful content containing domain JSON with cancelled:true is not classified as cancellation.
